body:
- [varLib] Support decreasing design-space axis mappings, via a new keyword-only `allow_decreasing` argument to `models.normalizeValue` (#3970, #4217, #4243).
- [designspaceLib] Allow partial DesignSpace v5 axis subsets: omitted range attributes on an `<axis-subset>` are taken from the parent axis, as the spec says (#4205).
- [designspaceLib] Fix `DesignSpaceDocument.normalize()` for mapped axes: axis bounds and rule conditions are now normalized from their original values (#4218).
- [designspaceLib] `splitInterpolable` and `splitVariableFonts` now warn when a source or instance is dropped because it lies outside the document's own axes, instead of silently discarding it (#4244).
- [varLib.instancer] Add support for instancing variable COLRv1 fonts (#2699, #4279).
- [varLib.instancer] Apply VVAR vertical-origin deltas to `VORG`, and use OpenType rounding for instanced advances and vertical origins (#4221).
- [varLib.instancer] Keep a universal FeatureVariations record when pinning removes its last condition but other axes remain (#4247).
- [varLib.instancer] Preserve ppem `Device` corrections in GDEF, BASE, GPOS and JSTF instead of asserting on them (#4290).
- [varLib.instancer] Allow requesting an axis's original range on VARC fonts (#4280).
- [varLib.instancer, subset] Fold, remove or remap MATH `VariationIndex` devices when instancing, subsetting the GDEF store or optimizing it (#4288).
- [varLib] Raise `ValueError: Missing required table fvar` from `varLib.mutator` and the instancer CLI on a static font, instead of a bare `KeyError` (#3751, #4300).
- [featureVars] When adding `rvrn`, also shift lookup indices inside existing FeatureVariations (#4233). Handle null `ConditionSet` and `FeatureTableSubstitution` offsets when building, subsetting and instancing (#4234, #4235). Keep `FeatureTableSubstitution` records sorted after merging new ones into an existing record (#4248).
- [ttLib] Fix FeatureParams (`size`, `ssXX`, `cvXX`) in FeatureVariations alternate feature tables, which failed to compile and round-trip (#3623, #4278).
- [ttLib] Fully decode lazily loaded ligatures, `SinglePos` and `PairPos` arrays during recursive decompilation, so `reorderGlyphs()` on a lazy font no longer corrupts or asserts on them (#4231, #4232).
- [VARC] Update the variation-store binary format to follow harfbuzz/boring-expansion-spec#175: `SparseVarRegionList.RegionCount` is uint32, sparse axes use Offset32 and `MultiVarData` items are stored in an INDEX. VARC fonts built with earlier fontTools versions must be rebuilt (#4219).
- [VARC] Several fixes: derive component conditions from `conditionIndex` (#4237), set the implicit `scaleY` when importing XML (#4238), report the font's current coordinates for components that reset unspecified axes (#4239), and keep inherited coordinates when drawing CFF2 VARC components (#4236).
- [varLib] `buildMultiVarData` accepts flattened per-region vector tuples (#4245).
- [otConverters] Bounds-check CFF2 INDEX count and `offSize` on read, raising `TTLibError` instead of allocating huge lazy lists (#4220).
- [ttLib] Handle empty packed deltas when `OPTIMIZE_FONT_SPEED` is set (#4241).
- [scaleUpem] Scale per-glyph `VORG` origins (#4222); fix VARC scaling for static fonts and condition variations (#4223); don't mutate the shared default CFF `FontMatrix` (#4251, #4252).
- [cmap] Fix format 2 compilation when all codes are single-byte (#1524, #4211) or all single-byte codes map to `.notdef` (#4215). Formats 2 and 4 now reject glyph IDs above 65535 instead of wrapping them (#4226). Split format 14 default UVS ranges longer than 256 codepoints (#4229). Empty format 12 and 13 subtables round-trip (#4246).
- [glyf] Use unsigned instruction lengths, so programs of 32768-65535 bytes compile and decompile correctly (#4227). Keep instructions in zero-contour glyphs (#4228).
- [pens] Fix cubic off-curve detection in `TTGlyphPointPen` across contour starts (#4224). `Glyph.drawPoints()` now raises `NotImplementedError` for an all-off-curve cubic contour, which the point pen protocol cannot express (#3191, #4225). `RoundingPen` passes the all-off-curve `None` sentinel through (#4311, #4312).
- [CFF2] Preserve operands when a blend has zero regions (#4240).
- [cffLib] Read CFF font names as Latin-1, matching how they are written (#4253). Deleting a CFF dict attribute now actually removes it (#2725, #4264).
- [CFF2ToCFF] Fix conversion of fonts with local subroutines (#4258). A CFF2 table with a single FontDict is now converted to a name-keyed CFF font that keeps its glyph names (#3890, #4265).
- [subset] Handle a null GDEF variation store (#4230).
- [merge] Support merging fonts that both have a MATH table (#3823, #4257).
- [feaLib] Reject the same mark class used twice in one anchor list (#3628, #4255). Don't crash on value records whose devices are all NULL (#2396, #4261). Pad a short OS/2 `Vendor` with spaces (#4259).
- [feaLib] Raise `FeatureLibError` with a location, instead of a bare Python error, for: a BASE script list without a matching tag list (#4263), a `UnicodeRange` bit outside 0-127 (#4266), a name string that cannot be decoded (#4267), a STAT axis `location` with no or too many values (#4268), and a non-ASCII OS/2 `Vendor` (#4269).
- [name] Fix the BCP 47 tags of some Mac and Windows language IDs, e.g. `es` was mapped to Mac Estonian (#3733, #4256). `getDebugName` prefers the Windows English name over the Mac one (#3969, #4273).
- [post] Don't crash on a format 2.0 table with `numGlyphs` set to 0 (#3060, #4274).
- [VDMX] Recompute `numRecs` and `numRatios` when compiling (#4293).
- [Silf] Fix compiling a `Silf` table that was decompiled from binary (#4294).
- [woff2] Preserve `minorVersion` when copying flavor data (#4249, #4250).
- [ttGlyphSet] Compute glyph width lazily for glyf variable fonts without HVAR, so `.width` is correct before drawing (#3964, #4260).
- [varLib.interpolatable] Respect designspace source layers (#3951, #4275); fix `--json` output with SciPy (#3870, #4276).
- [misc.psLib] Fix tokenizing of escaped parentheses in PostScript strings (#4207).
- [svgLib] Raise `ValueError` instead of `IndexError` on a truncated path command (#4254).
- [misc.transform] Preserve the direction of the remaining axis when decomposing a transform whose first column is zero (#4242).
- [misc.textTools] `Tag.__ne__` returns `NotImplemented` for unsupported types (#4305, #4306).
- [misc.dictTools] `hashdict` rejects in-place union (`|=`) (#4313, #4314).
- [misc.xmlReader] Close owned input streams when parsing fails (#4298).
- [misc.filesystem] `WriteZipFS.close()` can be called more than once (#4309, #4310).
- [EBDT] Keep EBDT/CBDT glyph metrics after probing a missing attribute (#3806, #4216).
